heroTitle: Expert care, rewarded with every order.
heroDescription: With the Biogance Loyalty Programme, every purchase lets you collect points and enjoy exclusive savings on your next dog and cat care essentials.
step1Description: Create your Biogance account or sign in to your existing customer area.
step2Description: Every €10 spent on Biogance products earns you 1 loyalty point. Redeem your points whenever you like — 1 point equals an instant €1 discount on your next order.
step3Description: Turn your points into discount vouchers from the very first point earned.
stat1Description: spent on Biogance products = 1 loyalty point
stat2Description: redeemed from your account = €1 instant discount on your next order
moreWaysDescription: Your loyalty can be rewarded beyond purchases, with occasional benefits reserved for members.
birthdayDescription: Receive bonus points to celebrate your birthday.
newsletterDescription: Collect points by subscribing to Biogance news.
satisfactionDescription: Share your feedback and receive additional benefits.
competitionsDescription: Enjoy special rewards during selected competitions or events.
exclusionNote: *Excluding shipping costs. Points are accumulated on all eligible orders placed from 4 September 2021. Orders placed before this date are not eligible for points. Programme terms may be subject to change.
